## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q -ra -W error` passes.
- [ ] `python validation/run_validation_v0232.py` passes when scientific behavior changes.
- [ ] Units, balance identities and timestep sensitivity were checked where applicable.
- [ ] Observation, action, reward and persisted-state contract changes are documented.
- [ ] No patient-identifiable, credentialed or redistribution-restricted data is included.
- [ ] Clinical claims remain within the documented research-only scope.

## Evidence

List numerical comparisons, references and limitations needed to review the
change. Use synthetic examples only.
